channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Só 1 partido tem mais mulheres do que homens entre candidatos
item.description: Among the 20,496 candidates registered for the 2026 municipal elections, only the Unidade Popular (UP) has more women than men, with 53% female candidates. Brazil has 35% female participation among all candidates, up 1 percentage point from 2022. UP also leads with a presidential ticket composed of two women.

item.title: VÍDEO: Inteligência artificial nas eleições — o que pode e o que não pode?
item.description: The TSE has regulated the use of artificial intelligence in the 2026 elections, allowing its use in electoral advertising as long as disclosure is provided. Deepfakes and manipulated content are prohibited, with restrictions on publishing new AI-generated content 72 hours before and 24 hours after voting.

item.title: Datafolha, 1º turno: veja intenção de voto por região, gênero, idade, posição política e religião
item.description: The Datafolha poll, conducted between August 18 and 20 with 2,058 respondents, shows Lula (PT) with 39% of first-round presidential vote intentions, against 33% for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The survey, commissioned by Folha de S.Paulo and TV Globo, breaks down results by region, gender, age, income, education, and religion, with a 95% confidence margin.

item.title: Taxação imposta ao Brasil é 'irreal e baseada em mentira', diz Lula a Trump
item.description: President Lula stated that Trump's proposed tariffs on Brazil are unrealistic and based on lies, during a speech in Belo Horizonte. He emphasized fair trade between nations.

item.title: Lula cobra maior agilidade de BB e Caixa na liberação de crédito a motoristas de app e táxi
item.description: Lula meets with Banco do Brasil and Caixa executives demanding faster credit releases for taxi and app drivers. Dissatisfied with the progress of credit lines, the president urges greater speed in vehicle financing for this group.

item.title: Lula diz que Trump “reconheceu” erro em tarifa ao Brasil
item.description: Lula stated, following a conversation with Trump, that the U.S. president acknowledged errors in tariffs imposed on Brazil, recognizing them as based on incorrect information. He challenged U.S. justifications regarding deforestation and slave labor, proposed joint action against organized crime without foreign interference, and emphasized the need to process strategic minerals domestically.

item.title: TSE: ministra pede mais tempo para analisar suspensão de pesquisa da AtlasIntel
item.description: TSE minister Estela Aranha requested more time to review the suspension of the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll that showed a decline for Flávio Bolsonaro. The suspension was based on allegations of voter inducement and methodological manipulation.

item.title: Mais de 3 milhões com benefícios federais são bloqueados em bets
item.description: Over 3 million federal social program beneficiaries had their betting site accounts blocked through the Sigap system, implemented to protect vulnerable populations. Mandated by the STF in 2024, the measure prevents the use of resources intended for welfare in online gambling. The system performs real-time automatic verification using CPF, without penalizing companies or users.

item.title: Lula: Precisamos resolver educação no País, faremos escola de tempo integral no Brasil inteiro
item.description: Lula states that social programs under his administration addressed basic needs of the poorest population and highlights education as a priority in a potential new term, proposing full-time schools across Brazil. He reaffirmed commitment to social policies during the launch of Patrus Ananias' gubernatorial campaign in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Lula: Sou candidato a presidente de novo porque não terminamos a nossa missão
item.description: Lula announced his candidacy for re-election, claiming he has not yet completed his political mission. He made the statement during the campaign launch of Patrus Ananias, also from the PT, for governor of Minas Gerais, in Belo Horizonte.

item.title: Cofundador da Grendene doa R$ 2,5 milhões para campanha de candidato ao governo do RS
item.description: Alexandre Grendeme Bartelle, co-founder of footwear company Grendeme, donated R$2.5 million to federal deputy Zucco's (PL-RS) gubernatorial campaign in Rio Grande do Sul. The donation is the largest received by a candidate from an individual so far, according to TSE data.

item.title: AO VIVO: LULA EM MINAS GERAIS FAZ COMÍCIO DAS ELEIÇÕES 2026 NA PRAÇA DA ESTAÇÃO
item.description: Lula visits Minas Gerais to speak at Praça da Estação, addressing economy, security and the 2026 campaign, sparking strong media and public reaction.

item.title: Lula diz que sugeriu a Trump “tomar um trago” com Xi e Putin
item.description: Lula suggested Trump arrange a meeting with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin to negotiate solutions for global conflicts, emphasizing peace and national sovereignty. During a visit to Minas Gerais, the president announced federal investments and reinforced his stance for the 2026 election race, criticizing foreign interference in Brazil.

item.title: Datafolha gela flavianos pós-blitzkrieg anti-Lula. Mendonça e isenção
item.description: A wave of headlines and leaked investigations aims to discredit Lula, yet the latest Datafolba poll shows unchanged numbers, indicating a tie between Lula and Flávio. The author questions the selectivity of leaks and pressures Minister Mendonça to revoke secrecy.

item.title: STF rejeita ação de Brandão para barrar investigação de Dino
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Court (STF) rejected an action filed by Maranhão governor Carlos Brandão seeking to halt a criminal investigation led by Minister Flávio Dino, ruling that the petition served personal interests rather than institutional defense. The decision, issued by Minister Dias Toffoli, kept the investigation ongoing, noting procedural deficiencies and that the action could not replace ordinary appeals. The case involves allegations of corruption in parliamentary amendments and appointments to the Maranhão audit court.

item.title: Veja como foi a sexta-feira (21) dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: On Friday (21), the presidential candidates carried out activities across various regions of Brazil, including debates, rallies and interviews. Key topics addressed included public security, worker welfare and public policies related to the economy and the environment.

item.title: Alcolumbre manda PECs do fim da escala 6×1 e da segurança para CCJ
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre forwarded two constitutional amendment bills to the CCJ: one ending the 6×1 shift schedule and another restructuring public security. The proposals, already approved by the Chamber, must now clear additional requirements in the Senate for promulgation.

item.title: O peso do eleitorado jovem na disputa Lula x Flávio, segundo pesquisa
item.description: Young voters (16-24) constituted 12% of the electorate in 2026, down from 18% in 2010 due to demographic aging. In a polarized race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, youth voting intentions remain split (Lula 38% vs. Flávio 32% in the first round; Lula 46% vs. Flávio 41% in the second), mirroring societal polarization.

item.title: Marcola pediu quadro de 100 mil euros a Roberta Luchsinger, aponta PF
item.description: Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, Lula's former chief of staff, was caught by the Federal Police requesting a €100,000 painting from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger in exchange for intermediating business interests. The investigation also reveals personal expense payments totaling R$217,000 from Luchsinger, including credit card bills, car financing, and jewelry. The PF has not confirmed delivery of the painting but flagged evidence of undue advantage.

item.title: Lula diz que sugeriu a Trump reunir Xi e Putin em seu resort na Flórida para buscar saída para conflitos
item.description: President Lula suggested to Trump a meeting at his Florida residence to mediate a discussion between Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, and other leaders on resolving global conflicts, emphasizing diplomacy as a path to peace. During a roughly 80-minute call, both leaders discussed bilateral trade relations, with Lula calling for a review of tariffs and Trump signaling the return of technical teams for negotiations. Lula also said he contacted Xi and Putin, urging multilateral diplomacy at the UN Security Council and asking Putin to return to politics to negotiate an end to the war in Ukraine.

item.title: Lula revela o que conversou com Trump: "Não queremos interferência no Brasil"
item.description: President Lula disclosed details of his conversation with Donald Trump, emphasizing respect for Brazilian sovereignty and rejecting justifications for tariffs. He advocated cooperation in combating organized crime without foreign interference and proposed an informal meeting with global leaders to promote peace.

item.title: Governo Lula reforça que não é avalista de empréstimo ao BRB, mas diz que segue colaborando
item.description: The federal government, through the AGU and the Ministry of Finance, denied being a guarantor of the R$ 6.6 billion loan to the Federal District government to recapitalize Banco de Brasília, stating the delay is due to technical, commercial, and governance issues. Celina Leão's administration (PP) accused the FGC and the Union of inertia, but the Supreme Court has yet to finalize the process as the operation remains pending due to the lack of a detailed business plan.

item.title: Datafolha anima petistas. Aliados de Flávio projetam reação
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Lula 6 points ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round and a technical tie in a second-round matchup. PT celebrates the numbers, while Flávio's campaign increases advertising and uses investigations to narrow the gap.

item.title: PF pede informações à Ancine sobre filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police requested information from Ancine regarding the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro, investigating potential irregularities in production and funding. The case is under review at the STF following documents revealing R$61 million transfers from Havengate Development Fund, linked to Eduardo Bolsonaro, to finance the movie.

item.title: Apenas Palmeiras, Galo, Vasco e Santos disputam três títulos em 2026
item.description: Palmeiras, Atlético-MG, Vasco, and Santos advanced to the Copa do Brasil quarterfinals and remain in international competitions in 2026. All four teams are strong contenders to win three titles simultaneously this season.

item.title: Entrevistas com os candidatos a presidente: Romeu Zema (Novo)
item.description: Globo will conduct live interviews with presidential candidates from August 24-29, aired after Jornal Nacional. The six candidates invited based on a Quaest poll include Romeu Zema (Novo), Lula (PT), Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and others. Full interviews will be available on Globoplay and g1 afterward.

item.title: Entrevistas com os candidatos a presidente: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL)
item.description: The 'Interviews with presidential candidates' program, airing from August 24 to 29, will broadcast live conversations with the six highest-ranked candidates in the Quaest poll, including Flávio Bolsonaro on August 28. The coverage will be hosted by Renata Vasconcellos and César Tralli, live from Globo Studios, with simultaneous streaming on g1 and GloboNews.

item.title: Entrevistas com os candidatos a presidente: Lula (PT)
item.description: The 'Interviews with Presidential Candidates' program will air live from August 24-29 from Globo Studios after the National News, also streamed on g1 and GloboNews. The six highest-rated candidates from the August 14th Quaest poll will be interviewed, with Lula (PT) scheduled for August 27th.

item.title: Primeiro debate presidencial: o que está em jogo e o que observar
item.description: The first 2026 presidential debate, hosted by Band, brings together six invited candidates, though not all are expected to attend. Electoral law ensures automatic participation for candidates from parties with at least five representatives in Congress, such as PT, PL, Avante, and PSD. Topics like economy, security, and health are expected to be discussed.

item.title: Entrevistas com os candidatos a presidente: Renan Santos (Missão)
item.description: Interviews with presidential candidates will take place live daily from August 24 to 29, broadcast from the Globo Studios after the National News, with simultaneous airing on g1 and GloboNews. The six candidates leading the Quaest poll released on August 14 will be interviewed in this order: Romeu Zema (24), Ronaldo Caiado (25), Renan Santos (26), Lula (27), Flávio Bolsonaro (28), and Augusto Cury (29). All content will be made fully available on Globoplay and g1 after broadcast.

item.title: Entrevistas com os candidatos a presidente: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD)
item.description: The 'Interviews with Presidential Candidates' program will be broadcast live from August 24 to 29, directly from Globo Studios, with streaming on g1, GloboNews, and Globoplay. Six candidates from the latest Quaest poll were invited, including Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), interviewed on August 25.

item.title: Entrevistas com os candidatos a presidente: Augusto Cury (Avante)
item.description: The 'Interviews with the presidential candidates' program will be broadcast live from August 24 to 29, directly from Globo Studios, featuring Renata Vasconcellos and César Tralli. The six candidates leading the latest Quaest survey were invited, including Augusto Cury (Avante), Lula, and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Agregador: Lula tem 7 pontos de vantagem sobre Flávio no 1º turno
item.description: One week after the start of the electoral campaign, UOL's poll aggregator shows Lula (PT) with a seven-point lead over Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the first round. The gap places the PT candidate ahead in the presidential race. The scenario indicates a polarized contest between PT and PL.

item.title: MP pede impugnação da candidatura de Gustavo Rocha no DF, mas STF retifica ata
item.description: The Electoral Prosecutor's Office requested the disqualification of Gustavo Rocha's candidacy (Republicans), former Secretary of the Civil House of the Federal District and running mate of Celina Leão (PP) for the DF governorship. However, the Supreme Court corrected the minutes, benefiting the ticket.

item.title: Casado: Campanha de Flávio aposta em 'onda favorável' no 2º turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) second-round campaign bets on a 'favorable wave' to overturn the race against Lula (PT), according to columnist Letícia Casado on the Canal UOL polling analysis. The strategy aims to mobilize aligned bases and reinforce narratives supportive of the prior administration.

item.title: Toledo: Só reviravolta faria Tarcísio não ser eleito no 1º turno em SP
item.description: Columnist José Roberto de Toledo assesses that only a major shift after the start of electoral advertising would prevent Tarcísio de Freitas from winning re-election as São Paulo governor in the first round of 2026.

item.title: Moraes tira aposentadoria de ex-diretor da PRF condenado por trama golpista
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes ruled to cancel the pension of Silvinei Vasques, former director of the Federal Highway Police convicted for participating in the 2022 coup plot. The decision upholds the loss of public office even though the defendant was already retired, based on STF jurisprudence. Vasques was sentenced to over 22 years in prison for state coup and violent abolition of the democratic state.

item.title: Caiado diz que Brasil não pode ser a “República dos filhos complicados”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, labeling the scenario a 'Republic of complicated sons.' The remark references investigations into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (influence peddling) and Flávio Bolsonaro (Dark Horse film financing). Caiado polls at 5% in Datafolha, trailing Lula (39%) and Flávio (33%).

item.title: Alcolumbre envia PEC do fim da escala 6x1 para CCJ do Senado
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre forwarded the PEC to end the 6x1 work shift to the CCJ, with Senator Omar Aziz as rapporteur. The proposal reduces the maximum weekly work hours to 40 and establishes two paid weekly rest days. Additionally, the Public Security PEC was also sent to the CCJ, under the rapporteurship of Rogério Carvalho.

item.title: Ministros do Brasil e Estados Unidos vão retomar negociação comercial
item.description: Brazilian ministers and USTR representatives will resume trade negotiations following a call between Lula and Trump, focusing on resolving tariff disputes and enhancing cooperation against organized crime.

item.title: Ministros do Brasil e EUA vão retomar negociação comercial
item.description: Brazil and U.S. ministers agreed to resume commercial negotiations after a call between Lula and Trump, who discussed tariffs and cooperation against organized crime. The meeting between MDIC, MRE, and USTR aims to resolve the dispute caused by U.S. measures on Brazilian products.

item.title: Mensagem de ex-chefe de gabinete de Lula mostra pedido de quadro de 100 mil euros a lobista; defesa nega recebimento da obra
item.description: Leaked police messages reveal that Lula's former chief of staff, Marcola, allegedly requested a €100,000 painting from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, who is under investigation for influence peddling. His defense denies receiving the artwork, claiming the exchange was a joke and that no business dealings occurred. Investigations also suggest Luchsinger sought to sell cannabidiol medications to the government through proposals sent via Marcola.

item.title: Datafolha: governo de Celina é aprovado por 47% e desaprovado por 44%
item.description: A Datafolha survey released on August 21 shows 47% of Brasília residents approve of Celina Leão's (PP) government, against 44% who disapprove, with 9% not answering. In the gubernatorial race, Celina and José Roberto Arruda (PSD) are statistically tied at 30% and 28% of voting intentions, respectively. In the spontaneous question, Celina leads with 21%, followed by Arruda (12%) and Leandro Grass (6%).

item.title: 'Dark Horse': PF pede à Ancine informações sobre cinebiografia de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal Police requested information from Ancine regarding the film 'Dark Horse', a biographical movie about Jair Bolsonaro, following a complaint of irregular filming in Brazil by a foreign producer. The case is linked to investigations into the film's funding, with suspicions of fund misdirection and possible use of money for Eduardo Bolsonaro's expenses in the US.

item.title: Vice de Flávio diz que três motivos levaram senador a escolhê-lo para a chapa presidencial
item.description: Alfredo Gaspar, running for vice president under Flávio Bolsonaro, cited three reasons for his selection: representing the Northeast, expertise in public security, and anti-corruption efforts. He stated the ticket aims to offer an alternative to the PT's alleged 'welfare statism,' emphasizing recipient training programs.

item.title: Rui Costa Pimenta critica atuação da PF e fala em uso “político”
item.description: Rui Costa Pimenta (PCO) criticizes the Federal Police, calling it a 'political police' with partial and abusive conduct. He cites Operation Car Wash against Lula and the raid on his own home as examples of media sensationalism and rights violations.

item.title: J&F, dos irmãos Batista, compra fabricante de armas de guerra Avibras
item.description: J&F, owned by the Batista brothers, agreed to acquire 100% of Nova AVB, parent company of Brazilian defense manufacturer Avibras Aeroco. The deal will be executed through Globe Investimentos and requires CADE approval. The acquisition aims to support Avibras' operational recovery, recently certified as a Strategic Defense Company and visited by President Lula in July.

item.title: Carla Araújo: Campanha de Lula prepara 'ataques' contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Carla Araújo reports that Lula's campaign has already devised a plan to escalate confrontation with Flávio Bolsonaro through strategic attacks. The strategy aims to gain advantage in the 2026 electoral landscape by increasing pressure on the PL candidate.

item.title: Candidato de Lula, Patrus tem a maior rejeição em MG, mostra Datafolha
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Patrus Ananias (PT) with highest rejection (29%) in Minas Gerais governor race, followed by Alexandre Kalil (23%). Cleitinho Azevedo leads voting intentions with 32%, while Patrus and Kalil tie at 12% each.

item.title: Marcos Rogério lidera corrida pelo governo de Rondônia
item.description: Phoenix poll shows Senator Marcos Rogério (PL) leading Rondônia gubernatorial race with 28.2% voting intention, followed by Adailton Fúria (PSD) at 19.35%. Survey interviewed 961 people from August 15-18, with 3.2 p.p. margin of error and TSE registration.
